dialogues.speaker: Little Pinecone
dialogues.text: If he doesn't have an opening, he'll make one! Great warriors find positions on the battlefield that suit them best — that's why we can't jump to conclusions based on the terrain alone!

dialogues.speaker: Flammabomb Wood Figure
dialogues.text: So true! Like "Malipo" always does: if the enemy drives him off, he'll take to the skies with a "whoosh," find a shortcut, and blindside them, lickety-split!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (They're still going at it... Maybe it's best not to bother these two for now...)
